items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: there’s a bass player around the city named John Montegna who does a version of “Love of Mine” and sings and plays bass. Great bass player.

ctx.x: Do you remember that moment specifically?

Absolutely. I had only heard him sing you know a bar here and a bar there. I never heard him sing a whole tune like that. Sometimes on stage he would say you know the first line of the song, but he never actually sang like that. So on that session, to hear him sing full throated and that husky baritone, it was great. And I love the lyrics and — there’s a bass player around the city named John Montegna who does a version of “Love of Mine” and sings and plays bass. Great bass player. And I heard his version and it…
So how did your mother feel about having five drum sets in the house?
